title: pm-dispatch: a chat message that lists options and waits for the maintainer is the popup 「卡先于弹窗」 forbids; say so where the rule lives
body:
## Source

On 2026-10-16 the `domain:ui` seat 4 (session `session_01SJn1GEkrbbBQkhGC26wEDw`) put two product decisions to the maintainer as chat prose with options, and waited for a reply. It filed no `needs-user-decision` card for either:

- objectui#12606: under Setup, hiding the Display control also hides Refresh and Export (A / B / C, asked at about 12:26Z). The maintainer's last input before it was at about 11:25Z.
- The cross-object record links in console lists (from PR objectstack-ai/objectui#12658's deviation), asked earlier the same day.

The maintainer's answers, verbatim: 「需要我决策的开决策卡」, then 「这种决策问题就是应该开决策卡，是skills 没写清楚嘛？skills也需要更新」. The seat then filed both decisions the way the skill says: the analysis comment on objectui#12606 (label `pm:dispatched` → `needs-user-decision`), and objectui#12673.

## Governing text today (`.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` on `main` `b9dbc3d895`)

- L20 「维护者只在两点进入循环:轮次报告,与 `needs-user-decision` 决策卡。」
- L268 「卡先于弹窗:需裁决先落 `needs-user-decision` 卡;收件箱由维护者定期消化,⛔ 不 assign 推送。」
- L270 「`AskUserQuestion` 只是在场加速器:仅当维护者在本会话 ~30 分钟内有过人类输入才可发。」

The rule exists, and the seat broke it. But the gap the seat fell through is real. 弹窗 reads as the `AskUserQuestion` widget only, and no line names a chat message that lists options and waits. The seat also read the maintainer's earlier stance 「什么决策具体和我说」 as a licence to ask in chat. That stance asks for the decision to be explained concretely; it does not open a second channel.

Re-check: `git show origin/main:.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md | grep -n '卡先于弹窗'` → 1 hit (control: `维护者只在两点进入循环`, same file).

## Target

One rule, stated where L268 already lives: any ask that waits for the maintainer to choose, whether a widget or chat prose that lists options, lands as a `needs-user-decision` card first. Chat then carries only the card link and one line. A stance like 「什么决策具体和我说」 is served by the card's 维护者速读 and the round report's link, not by a chat question.

## Constraints

- `SKILL.md` is at its ratchet ceiling (319 / 319 lines; 120 bytes a line). Amend L268 in place, or put the sentence on the matching line of `references/decision-analysis.md` 〈常设决裁批流程〉, whichever the skills seat measures as fitting. Add no line to `SKILL.md`.
- Text only. No new gate (新增门禁默认否).

## Acceptance

1. The amended line names chat prose that lists options as the same channel as the popup.
2. `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet`, `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `pnpm check:pm-governed-prose` and `pnpm check:skill-frame-sync` exit 0.

Filed by the `domain:ui` seat 4 on the maintainer's word above.
